fullPassage: Honey can be eaten by itself or mixed with other ingredients. Natural or pure honey has had no additives, preservatives or synthetic ingredients added. Also referred to as 'undiluted', it is usually more expensive than diluted honeys. Natural honey can also be called 'blended honey', in which honeys from various sources are blended together — not by the bees, but by human processors and distributors in stages after the honey has been collected. Blending is frequently done for taste as well as marketing reasons, especially since some consumers find the darker honeys too strong. Mixing different types of honey together can make it more palatable, and also gives a more uniform flavour — this is an important consideration for producers and retailers, who feel the need to guarantee reliable, unsurprising (typically mild) flavours to their customers. Clover is one of the most popular honeys in the U.S., and its mild flavour and taste have become familiar to many Americans.

❌ ① to as: 'referred to as'에서 전치사+접속사 구조 → 적절
✅ ② altogether: 원문은 together. 'blended together'에서 together(함께)가 적절. altogether(완전히/전혀)는 맥락상 부적절 ←정답
❌ ③ especially: 부사 'especially since' → 적절
❌ ④ typically: 부사 'typically mild' → 적절
det.tip: together(함께) vs altogether(완전히). blended together = 함께 섞인

questions.passage: Honey can be eaten by itself or mixed with other ingredients. Natural or pure honey has had no additives, preservatives or synthetic ingredients added. Also referred to as 'undiluted', it is usually more expensive than diluted honeys. Natural honey can also be called 'blended honey', in which honeys from various sources are blended together — not by the bees, but by human processors and distributors in stages after the honey has been collected. Blending is frequently done for taste as well as marketing reasons, especially since some consumers find the darker honeys too strong. Mixing different types of honey together can make it more palatable, and also gives a more uniform flavour — this is an important consideration for producers and retailers, who feel the need to guarantee reliable, unsurprising (typically mild) flavours to their customers. Clover is one of the most popular honeys in the U.S., and its mild flavour and taste have become familiar to many Americans.

det.korean: 천연 꿀과 블렌딩된 꿀의 차이, 블렌딩 이유, 균일한 맛 보장
det.analysis:
❌ ① 벌의 꿀 제작: 본문은 벌의 생산 과정이 아닌 인간의 가공 과정
❌ ② 규제와 법적 기준: 본문에 규제/법률 언급 없음

✅ ④ 꿀의 종류와 블렌딩: 천연/블렌딩 꿀 구분 + 블렌딩 이유(맛/마케팅) + 결과(균일한 맛) ←정답
det.tip: 글의 핵심: 천연 꿀 vs 블렌딩 꿀, 블렌딩의 이유(맛+마케팅), 균일한 맛 보장
